{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a central repository for capturing and tracking all fresh ideas generated within the team.

## Structure
- **Idea ID**: Unique identifier.
- **Title**: Short descriptive title.
- **Description**: Detailed explanation.
- **Owner**: Person responsible.
- **Status**: (e.g., New, In Review, Approved, Implemented, Archived)
- **Priority**: (1-5, 5 highest)
- **Date Created**: Timestamp.
- **Notes**: Additional remarks.

## How to Use
1. Add a new entry whenever an idea is proposed.
2. Update status and notes as the idea progresses.
3. Archive ideas that are no longer relevant.

---

### Example Entry
| Idea ID | Title | Description | Owner | Status | Priority | Date Created | Notes |
|---------|-------|-------------|-------|--------|----------|--------------|-------|
| 001 | AI Chatbot | Develop an AI chatbot for customer support | Alice | New | 4 | 2026-10-05 | Initial concept.
", "file_name": "fresh_ideas.txt"}

{"file_content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a central repository for capturing and tracking all fresh ideas generated within the team.

## Structure
- **Idea ID**: Unique identifier.
- **Title**: Short descriptive title.
- **Description**: Detailed explanation.
- **Owner**: Person responsible.
- **Status**: (e.g., New, In Review, Approved, Implemented, Archived)
- **Priority**: (1-5, 5 highest)
- **Date Created**: Timestamp.
- **Notes**: Additional remarks.

## How to Use
1. Add a new entry whenever an idea is proposed.
2. Update status and notes as the idea progresses.
3. Archive ideas that are no longer relevant.

---

### Example Entry
| Idea ID | Title | Description | Owner | Status | Priority | Date Created | Notes |
|---------|-------|-------------|-------|--------|----------|--------------|-------|
| 001 | AI Chatbot | Develop an AI chatbot for customer support | Alice | New | 4 | 2026-10-05 | Initial concept.
"}

- **Idea ID**: Unique identifier.

## Purpose
This document serves as a central repository for capturing and tracking all fresh ideas generated within the team.

## Structure
- **Idea ID**: Unique identifier.
- **Title**: Short descriptive title.
- **Description**: Detailed explanation.
- **Owner**: Person responsible.
- **Status**: (e.g., New, In Review, Approved, Implemented, Archived)
- **Priority**: (1-5, 5 highest)
- **Date Created**: Timestamp.
- **Notes**: Additional remarks.

1. Add a new entry whenever an idea is proposed.
2. Update status and notes as the idea progresses.
3. Archive ideas that are no longer relevant.

"}

## Purpose
This document serves as a central repository for capturing and tracking all fresh ideas generated within the team.

## Structure
- **Idea ID**: Unique identifier.
- **Title**: Short descriptive title.
- **Description**: Detailed explanation.
- **Owner**: Person responsible.
- **Status**: (e.g., New, In Review, Approved, Implemented, Archived)
- **Priority**: (1-5, 5 highest)

1. Add a new entry whenever an idea is proposed.
2. Update status and notes as the idea progresses.
3. Archive ideas that are no longer relevant.

## Purpose
This document serves as a central repository for capturing and tracking all fresh ideas generated within the team.

## Structure
- **Idea ID**: Unique identifier.
- **Title**: Short descriptive title.

- **Owner**: Person responsible.

1. Add a new entry whenever an idea is proposed.

|---------|-------|-------------|-------|--------|----------|--------------|-------|

"}
